text: 会议指出，要推动“十五五”期间住房城乡建设立法工作蓝图落地见效，全面把握健全住房和房地产基础性法律制度、改革工程质量安全和建筑市场管理法律制度、构建城市更新和历史文化保护传承法律制度、建立健全城市管理和城市运行法律制度等目标任务，区分轻重缓急，分类有序推进，确保取得实效；统筹立法任务与业务工作，做好年度任务分解，提高立法质量和效率。（中国建设报）
text_en: The meeting pointed out that it is necessary to promote the effective implementation of the blueprint for housing and urban-rural development legislation during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, comprehensively grasp the objectives and tasks of improving the basic legal system for housing and real estate, reforming the legal system for engineering quality and safety and construction market management, building a legal system for urban renewal and historical and cultural protection and inheritance, and establishing and improving the legal system for urban management and urban operation, distinguish priorities, advance in an orderly and categorized manner, and ensure practical results; coordinate legislative tasks with business work, do a good job in decomposing annual tasks, and improve the quality and efficiency of legislation. (China Construction News)
